summary: Google's first big JavaScript framework, which made single-page web apps mainstream with two-way data binding. Google rewrote it from scratch as Angular, kept the original on long-term support, and ended it at the close of 2021.

icon.licence: MIT (the mark itself belongs to its owner)

events.label: Rewrite news
events.note: Google announces Angular 2, a rewrite that will not be compatible.

events.label: LTS begins
events.note: Active development stops and version 1.7 moves to long-term support.
Long-term support ends; Google no longer fixes security or browser issues.

cause: Rewritten from scratch as Angular; the original reached end of support.
